title: Console dashboards rollout: stakeholder heatmap, orchestration playbook, and release-notes cadence
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Create an actionable playbook for the new cost & performance dashboards and rollout controls that maps stakeholders, release-notes cadence, training materials, and escalation paths. This ticket coordinates cross-functional activities (Eng, Design, Support, Docs, Growth) required for a safe staged activation to customers.

Scope:
- Finalize the stakeholder heatmap and RACI for launch phases.
- Produce an internal release-notes brief (engineering + PM + legal signoff) and the external customer release notes.
- Build 3 micro-training modules for CS/Support/Solutions (webinar + one-pager + Slack snippets).
- Draft runbook for staggered activation waves and emergency rollback criteria.
- Prepare announcement templates for email, in-console banner, and community channels.

Out-of-scope: pricing changes, Dedicated capacity SLA updates, and API contract changes (separate PM tickets).

Primary stakeholders:
- Product: Asha Patel (owner), Miguel Torres (launch lead)
- Engineering: Dalia Nguyen (runtime), Rajesh Iyer (console)
- Design: Priya Sharma (visual + microcopy)
- Docs: Elena Park (release notes + help center)
- Support/CS: Marco Alvarez (training lead)
- Growth/Comms: Nina Osei (external comms)

Key artifacts and links:
- Draft playbook (Confluence): https://redwood.example.com/confluence/console-rollout-playbook-20458 
- Release notes draft (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/console-release-20458 
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/6523, https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4982 
- Dashboard preflight checks (internal): https://internal.redwood.com/dashboards/preflight-20458

Success metrics (post-GA):
- Adoption: 30% of active teams opt in to cost breakdown within 30 days.
- Support volume: <10% increase in tickets on day-1 (triage acceptable).
- Error rate: no regression in console latency SLOs; dashboard render P95 < 600ms on average.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: customers misinterpret cost breakdowns causing billing queries. Mitigation: include clear explanatory one-pagers, tooltips, and CS talking points.
- Risk: rollout reveals a backend performance edge-case. Mitigation: gated activation with canary cohort and automatic rollback thresholds tied to request latency and error budget.

Deliverables:
- Stakeholder heatmap + RACI (Confluence)
- Internal and external release notes (Docs + Draft PR for approval)
- Three micro-training artifacts (slides, 15-min webinar script, Slack snippets)
- Activation runbook with wave definitions and rollback playbook
- Announcement copy for email, in-console banner, product changelog, and community forum

Timeline:
- 2025-02-18: kickoff (done)
- 2025-02-25: stakeholder heatmap + initial release notes draft (done)
- 2025-03-04: training drafts and playbook v0.2 (in review)
- 2025-03-12: canary wave 1 activation prep (target)
- 2025-03-19: canary wave 1 activation
- 2025-03-26: broader wave activations if metrics OK
- 2025-04-01: GA (target)

Notes: Keep release notes customer-facing language focused on value (cost clarity, actionable insights) rather than internal implementation details. Coordinate with Legal for any billing-related phrasing.
